Xiamen University's AI teaching guideline applies to Xiamen University teachers and students using generative AI services for on-campus course teaching activities.
Xiamen University's AI teaching guideline says teachers should state in their courses which generative AI services students may use or are prohibited from using.

Xiamen University's AI teaching guideline says students using generative AI services in course learning should actively disclose that use to the teacher and accurately mark the contribution of generative AI when required by the teacher.
Xiamen University's AI teaching guideline says students should strictly observe data protection principles and must not enter sensitive data into generative AI tools.

Xiamen University's AI teaching guideline says the university may handle improper use of generative AI under higher-education academic misconduct rules, Xiamen University academic misconduct rules, and student disciplinary rules.
